selection_procedure_change: Nested chronological probability-model selection and independent fixed-$5 policy evaluation replace the prior $100 development-balance selector. This is a new experiment, not an accounting correction.

common_sample.proxy_quotes: include and report source and proxy flag

market_reference.interpretation: probability reference only; never an execution price

btc_probability_input: existing causal calibrated p_BTC only; do not compare raw or alternate BTC variants

model_families.C: existing L2 logistic regression with intercept on logit(p_market)
model_families.D: existing free L2 logistic regression with intercept on logit(p_market) and logit(p_BTC)
model_families.E: p=(1-w)*p_market+w*p_BTC; select w from the frozen grid
model_families.F: logit(p)=logit(p_market)+a+b*(logit(p_BTC)-logit(p_market)); penalize a and b toward zero

parameter_grids.parameter_selection_metric: lowest pooled validation log loss over the predeclared inner folds; C/D ties choose lower C, E ties choose lower w, F ties choose exact no correction then higher lambda

probability_evaluation.outer_development_folds: all models compared on identical May and June market rows; C-F fitted/tuned only on each outer prefix using its configured inner folds
probability_evaluation.calibration_bin_edges: forecast-specific deciles fitted on nested development OOF predictions; reused unchanged on holdout
probability_evaluation.block_bootstrap: paired moving 3-day UTC blocks, 1000 replicates, seed 20261012

independent_order_economics.execution_rule: same T-60 side and requested amount; ask-side fee-adjusted FAK fill from actual T-59 snapshot, preserving accepted minimum, partial-fill, depth and proxy rules

policy_selection_rule.ranking: highest lower 95% bootstrap bound, then higher mean daily net PnL; if none qualify select no-trade

frozen_policy_portfolio.sizing: 5% of free cash at T-60, no additional dollar cap or stake increase
frozen_policy_portfolio.purpose: holdout feasibility of the development-frozen policy only

fixed_execution_comparisons.evaluation: same filled market-side pairs selected by A or D; keep T-59 execution, fee, net shares, cash debit and realized payout fixed while rescoring p_side and expected net EV for every declared forecast

limits: The July-October historical holdout was viewed before this experiment; all holdout metrics are diagnostic, not independent confirmation.
The nested development OOF excludes the April prefix used for early-fold fitting and covers only the two predeclared May and June outer folds.
Policy bootstrap intervals are conditional on each fixed candidate; they do not adjust for selecting across models and thresholds. The conservative no-trade gate is predeclared.
No main BTC model training, refit, book replay, live configuration change, or live order is part of this experiment.
